item.title: Is it possible to use the NSX bridge within NSX Federation to extend a network for a single global segment to a VLAN in multiple locations?
item.description:
Introduction

NSX Federation is a multi site solution for NSX available since NSX 3.0. After Federation was released, the feature set was very limited and many features like VRF and NSX bridge were not supported with Federration.

Overview of some enhancements with NSX 4.x:

  • Support of Physical Servers in Federated Environments (4.0.0.1)
  • Support of DFW Exclusion List (4.0.1.1)
  • DFW Time-based rules (4.0.1.1)
  • Overall Enable/Disable of Location DFW (4.0.1.1)
  • L2 Bridge (4.1.0.0)
  • Higher latency allowed between locations: Increased from 150 msec to 500 msec (4.1.0.0)
  • VRF Lite feature can now be used with global T0 routers as parent T0 (4.2.1)

In this article we will focus on the feature for NSX Bridge and validate if it is possible to stretch the same layer2 network simultaneously in both locations.
